note: Monsters now have personalities: every creature type fights its own way. Wolves circle and switch targets, rats panic and run when hurt, slimes and skeletons never run at all, ogres and trolls plant their feet and trade blows, and bandit archers hold their distance and keep shooting instead of closing to melee. Wounded beasts flee when their kind would flee — but a fleeing beast can still be chased down and killed, never escapes forever — and creatures growl, squeak, and roar as they spot you, flee, or fall. Sneak detection is unchanged: monsters still only notice a sneaking player within 12 paces.
